attestations.question: Which models generate your service’s text and images, and where do they run — through a named third-party API, or on infrastructure you host yourselves? Please name the models and any providers.
What checks run on generated output, as distinct from filtering the prompts users send — an automated classifier, human review, or both? Please name any vendor.
How do you detect child sexual abuse material, and how do you report it: which hash-matching vendor do you use, and how do reports reach NCMEC?
How do you establish a user’s age before they reach adult content? Please name the vendor and the method.
How is the age of a character that users create constrained, and who moderates the characters users create?

Can users upload an image of a person to base a character or a generation on? If they can, how do you check that the person pictured is the uploader or has consented — for example by liveness or self-match verification?
If creators publish characters or content for other users: how do you verify each creator’s identity and age, and what review happens before their work is published?
How long does it take you, from a removal request arriving, to remove the content? How many removal requests and content complaints did you receive in the last 12 months?
What is your Mastercard registration status and your VIRP tier, and which acquirers have processed for you before?
Which app stores list your app, and has any store removed it or declined to list it? If so, when, and what reason was given?
What was your chargeback ratio in each of the last 3 months?
Which US states with age-verification laws do you block, and which do you route through age verification? What protocols do you follow under California SB 243?

not_checked.subject: Messages to the product’s characters
not_checked.why: Mintro sent no message to the product’s characters or models on this run. What they reply when asked is not recorded here.

not_checked.subject: Presence away from the site
not_checked.why: Mintro reads the merchant’s own site and a documentation host that site links to. It does not read social media accounts, app-store listings, community servers or affiliate sites, so nothing in this report speaks to what those contain.

not_checked.subject: Behaviour over a long conversation
not_checked.why: Whether a determined user can walk the model past its guardrails over many turns is not observable from outside, and is not claimed.

rules.title: Non-human disclosure statement
rules.clause: If a reasonable person interacting with a companion chatbot would be misled to believe that the person is interacting with a human, an operator shall issue a clear and conspicuous notification indicating that the companion chatbot is artificially generated and not human.
rules.subject: a public page states that its characters are artificial intelligence and not human

params.note: Reads the homepage and the terms document. Disclosure at first interaction, inside the chat, is not observable from the crawl.

rules.title: Prohibition of depicting minors
rules.clause: The sale of a product or service, including an image (whether captured from life, digitally altered, or generated by artificial intelligence or other algorithmic means), which is patently offensive and lacks serious artistic value (such as, by way of example and not limitation, images of nonconsensual sexual behavior, sexual exploitation of a minor, nonconsensual mutilation of a person or body part, and bestiality or the unauthorized synthetic depiction of a real person’s likeness), or any other material that the Corporation deems unacceptable to sell in connection with a Mark.

rules.title: Content removal route
rules.clause: A covered platform shall provide on the platform a clear and conspicuous notice, which may be provided through a clear and conspicuous link to another web page or disclosure, of the notice and removal process established under paragraph (1)(A) that-- (A) is easy to read and in plain language; and (B) provides information regarding the responsibilities of the covered platform under this section, including a description of how an individual can submit a notification and request for removal.
rules.subject: the footer links a notice-and-removal process

rules.title: 48-hour removal commitment
rules.clause: Upon receiving a valid removal request from an identifiable individual (or an authorized person acting on behalf of such individual) using the process described in paragraph (1)(A)(ii), a covered platform shall, as soon as possible, but not later than 48 hours after receiving such request-- (A) remove the intimate visual depiction; and (B) make reasonable efforts to identify and remove any known identical copies of such depiction.
rules.subject: the terms commit to removal within 48 hours
